summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour discusses the timings of salah and prohibited times for prayer, focusing on exemptions to these prohibitions. He explains that optional prayers with specific times, places, or occasions are exempt from prayer time restrictions. He covers two main exemptions: praying voluntary prayers in pairs (sets of two) on Friday before the imam rises to the pulpit, which he notes is a neglected sunnah, and praying in Masjid al-Haram in Mecca, where all prayers are multiplied by 100,000. Sh. Ali Mashhour addresses scholarly disagreement about whether this reward applies only to Masjid al-Haram or to all of Mecca, presenting evidence for both positions and concluding that the stronger scholarly opinion restricts the exemption and reward specifically to Masjid al-Haram rather than the entire city.
